wire.skill_adoption.preview_required: This local skill needs a merge preview before it can be linked. Run `lop skills pull <id> --dry-run`, review both diffs, then confirm that preview with `--adopt-receipt <receipt> --yes`.
wire.skill_adoption.preview_changed: The local skill, Hub revision, or link policy changed after this preview. Create a new preview and review it before applying.
wire.skill_adoption.needs_choice: A consolidated version could not be produced safely. Preview an explicit choice: keep local and link, or take the Hub version with a backup.
wire.skill_adoption.preview_title: Review local and Hub guidance before linking
wire.skill_adoption.cancelled: Cancelled. The local skill was not changed.
wire.skill_adoption.dry_run_help: Preview installation or adoption without changing the local skill
wire.skill_adoption.receipt_help: Apply this previously reviewed adoption preview
wire.skill_adoption.strategy_help: Choose merge, keep-local, or take-hub for the adoption preview
wire.skill_adoption.no_llm_help: Do not send skill text to a merge model
wire.skill_adoption.no_apply: Preview only. Nothing was installed or linked.
wire.skill_adoption.inherited_assets: Local assets are preserved without being sent to the merge model.
wire.skill_adoption.yes_help: Confirm the reviewed installation or adoption preview
wire.skill_adoption.alias_occupied: A local skill already uses this name. Pull the Hub skill with --dry-run to review an adoption merge, or choose another name.
